title: Project Intake
description: Schema for initial project information submitted by user

project_name.description: Name or title of the project

location_description.description: Detailed description of project location including state/region, proximity to grid, population
examples: Rural community in Kaduna State, approximately 45km from nearest grid connection. Population ~1,200 across 200 households.

capacity_kw.description: Installed capacity in kilowatts (for generation projects)

target_beneficiaries.description: Description of who will benefit from the project (households, institutions, businesses)
examples: 200 households, 1 cassava processing cooperative, 2 schools, 1 health post

ownership_model.description: Who will own the project assets

productive_uses.description: Income-generating or productive activities enabled by the project

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated total project cost in USD

existing_funding.description: Any funding already secured or committed
examples: Community has committed $15,000 in cash and in-kind contributions

community_engagement.description: Description of community involvement and buy-in
examples: Cooperative formed in 2021 with 180 member households. Monthly meetings held.

additional_context.description: Any other relevant information about the project
examples: Area has strong solar resource (5.2 kWh/m2/day average). DISCO confirms no grid extension planned.
